judgments.rationale: The image is a 24x24 globe icon (the crop shows a globe) inside the language-switcher link whose own text is 'Outros idiomas'. The patch would drop the release name, which is the information the card exists to show.

The patch 'Calendário mensal de divulgações' would remove what the card is about.
